data.name: Kiswaan
data.gender_notes: Kiswaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘kiswah’ meaning ‘cloth’ or ‘robe’, which was originally used to refer to the cloth that covered the Kaaba in Mecca. In Islamic tradition, the Kiswa is believed to symbolize purity, devotion, and the unity of God. The name Kiswaan carries the meaning “Loin Cloth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kiswaan usually hope their child will grow to embody loin cloth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the purity and devotion of one's faith.
data.etymology: Kiswaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loin Cloth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiswaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
